limitations: Acceptance covers tested straight-edge road construction history and successful compensation of one-shot Zoning refusals; it does not close road history generally.

ImmediateFailedLeaf uses separate Playwright evaluate calls for commit and undo, with no explicit settlement between them. The evidence does not establish the same renderframe or a still-pending 60 ms journal; source does settle before rollback capture.

FastDouble runs both commits synchronously in one evaluate. Its afterUndoA digest is omitted; baseline equality is a retained harness boolean. Other compared digest rows are retained and were independently compared.

Later-state and later-construction post-undo/redo records are not retained. Equality flags were audited against harness logic, not independently recomputed from absent records. The construction predicate checks both exact building record and inverse lot buildingId.

Later construction uses real Buildings demolish/requestSpawn/flush owner APIs plus one Simulation step; this is not native UI construction or a long autonomous growth session. Unrelated later demolition is source-supported but not separately exercised.

Main matrix exactness uses its saved stable projection, selected owners, terrain digest and 21 samples, not an entire raw world/render byte image. History-boundary hashes instead cover complete seven-owner serialization including all serialized Terrain values and Simulation.

Cross-seed terrain changed/maxAbs only accumulate differences above 1e-6. Zero of 263169 is therefore tolerance-qualified, not independently proven bitwise equality of retained raw arrays; hashes are sampled/quantized and arrays are absent.
Legacy evidence strips Zoning to cells in a current normalized seed-7 save, then restores twice. It is not coverage of all historical save versions or raw full-module exactness.

Initial commit rebuild failures, secondary terrain-triggered road rebuild failures, later owner exceptions, persistent compensation refusal, road demolition and curved splits are outside positive coverage. Persistent failed compensation has no demonstrated recoverable road-leaf journal.

API double deserialize tests Democity only. Save rollback compares normalized canonical state through retained equality booleans, includes one expected injected Transit error, and is distinct from road-leaf compensation.

All eight originals and four x4 differences plus contact sheet were inspected individually at original resolution. There are no undo/redo screenshots; baseline/candidate means transaction absent/present on R9t, not pre/post source.

Traffic/foliage differ between captures. Image MAE is not a visual-quality or foliage-only metric. No timing, GPU, raw-heap, forced-GC, night/weather, blind judging or whole-game gate pass follows from this round.
